title: Russian Interference in French Presidential Elections: Gabriel Attal Files Complaint
description:
Gabriel Attal, a candidate in the 2027 French presidential elections, has filed a complaint alleging Russian interference through disinformation campaigns. His legal team claims that various accounts on social media platform X have disseminated false information, including fabricated health issues and misleading articles, aimed at discrediting him and other candidates. This follows alerts from French authorities regarding a series of destabilizing operations attributed to Russian networks. Attal's complaint emphasizes the potential impact on national interests and the integrity of the upcoming elections. Similar attacks have targeted other candidates, including Edouard Philippe and Raphaël Glucksmann, indicating a broader campaign of disinformation. The French government has condemned these actions and is investigating the incidents. Attal's legal representatives warn that without protective measures, the electoral process could be compromised.

Key Points:
• Gabriel Attal filed a complaint against Russian interference in the 2027 elections.
• Disinformation campaigns involved false health claims and fabricated articles targeting candidates.
• French authorities are investigating multiple incidents of digital interference linked to Russian networks.
